items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: And Lorenzo Stahls, I hauled off and hit him with my bass bow and broke it.

ctx.x: Then it looked like it got way up there to some of the guys in the line in the back. Then they started to holler at Montutti. And there I was, joking so funny. Oh, come on there, Montutti. To-doot. See, right away, he'd blow it off the head off so he could start it. And there I was, joking so funny. Oh, come on there, Montutti. To-doot. See, right away, he'd blow it off the head off so he could start it. He could start it. Man, I set the drum down at my level. And they start the playing it off. And they had no…
Don't worry, I'll get you. Oh, how did you happen to have so much money? Hmm? Where were you getting the money?
